content: Dewitdi malabumuŋ gineŋ hali ninadi tuguk
Yahwe, du kwihita tiŋila mu nanintobeŋ. Du welege kudup daune nemek malabumuŋ mu tinambeŋ.
Du tebegedi fiyagila nalamuŋaŋ, eŋ kohogedi nula tukulune maaŋ foŋat.
Du kwihita tinamulaŋ, doktiŋa nu folofigita wapum gineŋ hatat. Kadakaniŋne doktiŋa yagit malabumuŋ hinek tilat.
Yomnedi foloone foloŋ looŋ nehikufula tilak. Kaŋ yom wendi bomboŋ moŋgole malabudaiŋ wendok tuwot hinek nehitubu-malabudalak.
Wede foloone foloŋ ikiiŋ adi bitaka tiŋa tabut tiiŋ. Na titiŋ hogoli hinek tugut doktiŋa u mintanamulak.
Welemulap wapum hinek nadiŋa agaŋ kadaka tilat. Doktiŋa helemahelemaŋ bulaniŋgoŋ nadiŋa makat hati-kotat.
Foloone foloŋ adi kudup daaŋ nibune nadiyam undiniŋ kudup dadapmaune, yagit malabumuŋ hinek tilat.
Nu nemek niŋdi nehinalitifooŋ napme-hatak wendok tuwot gweheyedapmaaŋ fooŋ hatat. Tiŋa welene gineŋ moŋ hinek nadiŋa koyone ha-tilat.
Wapum, welenedi maŋgoŋdok hinek nadilat u agaŋ nadilaŋ, eŋ koyone tilat u miŋgoŋ nadilaŋ.
Siyotne goŋgomeŋdi pitpit tubune saŋiniŋne agaŋ dapmahinaka tilak. Eŋ yagit tibe namandatne haŋinda tilak.
Notneye eŋ manemaneye, adi yadi wedene doktiŋa nu hatatneŋ yamaiŋgoŋ uŋoŋ bubuŋdok adi moŋ nadiiŋ. Kaŋ na’walaŋ naŋgat dikineye hinekdi maaŋ undugoŋ nu hatatneŋ uŋoŋ mu biiŋ.
Me nulukumuŋ titiŋdok nadiiŋ adi yadi nohonedok yoŋa begep ibitehinamuŋa hakiiŋ. Eŋ me nehitubu-figita titiŋdok tiiŋ heki nehigoŋ nehitubu-kadaka titiŋdok yoiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ, nu adi magitne kauleeŋ dabugoŋ magi kametnadi mu tugut, eŋ me bubuyeŋ dabugoŋ mede mu yogut.
Nu adi me niŋ, mede tuwot mu nadiwek wendok tuwot. Unduŋ doktiŋa nu mede toboniŋ mu tubu-udaneyemgut.
Iŋgoŋ nu adi Yahwe dutok hogok woomgamuŋa nadisugamulat. Wapum, du Bepaŋne, unduŋ doktiŋa du dagoŋ medene tubu-udanenambeŋ.
Yonadi indiŋ tilat, “Du memikneye biyabune yofitet tinamuŋa nadifo mu tineŋ. Be malabumuŋ mintanambune nabuŋa biyabune foko tiŋa nadifo mu taneeŋ.”
Maŋgoŋde, ya agaŋ mandifaidok naine muniniŋ tulune folofigita helemahelemaŋ nadilat.
Nu yomne ganimbihila kadakaniŋ tugut wendoktiŋa bulaniŋgoŋ nadilat.
Memikneye hogohogok adi yadi kedehi tiŋa fafaŋehi. Tiŋa me feedi memik hogok tinamfit tiiŋ.
Nu titiŋ momooŋ tiyemilat iŋgoŋ oŋ, kibi toboniŋ adi titiŋ hogoli tinamiiŋ. Nu titiŋ momooŋ keleeŋ tilat, kaŋ adi wendoktiŋa nadiŋa memik tinamiiŋ.
Yahwe, du mu binabeŋ. Bepaŋne, du binabuŋa wooŋ kweetniŋ mu haleŋ.
Yahwe, du kubugoŋdi nehitubu-lodaaŋ kotigoŋ nanagitaŋ. Du pilap hinek nehitubu-lodaweŋ.
